colors.name: Colours
colors.accent_info: Clay orange. Primary buttons and links.
colors.data_info: Electric blue. Reserved for dosage figures — never buttons, links or decoration.

typography.name: Typography
typography.self_hosted_info: Three roles: a display face for headings, a body face for reading, and a monospaced data face for every price, dose and nutrition value.
typography.use_brand_fonts: Use the Kinetic Labs brand fonts
typography.use_brand_fonts_info: Fraunces, Inter and JetBrains Mono, self-hosted in the theme. Turn this off to pick fonts from the Shopify font library instead.
typography.data_info: The monospaced face is fixed so that columns of figures always align. You can still adjust its letter spacing.

layout.name: Layout
layout.spacing_base_info: Every gap in the theme is a multiple of this. 8px is the design default.

motion.name: Motion
motion.reduced_motion_info: All motion is switched off automatically for visitors who ask their device to reduce motion.

product_card.name: Product cards
product_card.show_rating_info: Requires a review app that writes to the reviews.rating metafield.
product_card.swatch_option_name_info: The product option to render as swatches. Must match the option name on your products exactly.

cart.name: Cart
cart.free_shipping_threshold_info: In your store currency, without a symbol. Leave blank to hide the bar.

compliance.name: Compliance
compliance.info: This text appears in the footer on every page. It is translatable per market — edit it under each market's language in Settings → Languages.

shared.heading: Heading
shared.title: Title
shared.label: Label
shared.app_block_info: Add an app block here for reviews, subscriptions or back-in-stock alerts.

announcement_bar.name: Announcement bar
announcement_bar.market_info: Enter a comma-separated list of market handles, or leave blank to show everywhere.

header.name: Header
header.transparent_info: Only applies when the first section on the page is a hero or slideshow.
header.mega_menu_item_info: Must match a top-level item in your main menu, exactly.

footer.name: Footer
footer.disclaimer_info: Required. Editable per market under Settings → Languages.
footer.use_global_disclaimer: Use the disclaimer from theme settings

cart_drawer.name: Cart drawer
cart_drawer.show_recommendations: Show recommendations when the cart is empty

hero.name: Hero
hero.trust_line_info: Short proof points shown under the buttons.

dosage_panel.name: Dosage panel
dosage_panel.info: Renders the selected product's custom.dose_comparison metafield as comparison bars. Figures use the data typeface and the data colour.

ingredient_philosophy.name: Ingredient philosophy
ingredient_philosophy.typical_rows_info: One per line, formatted as “Name | Amount”.
ingredient_philosophy.our_rows_info: One per line, formatted as “Name | Amount”. Amounts render in the data typeface.

review_highlight.name: Review highlight
review_highlight.author: Name
review_highlight.app_slot_info: Add your review app's block here to replace these placeholders with live reviews.

subscribe_promo.name: Subscribe promo
subscribe_promo.saving_amount_info: State the saving in currency, e.g. $126/yr.

instagram_grid.name: Instagram grid
instagram_grid.info: Static images. A live feed needs a UGC app — add its block to the app section instead.

video.name: Video
video.video_url_info: YouTube or Vimeo. Use the Video field above for a hosted file.
video.autoplay_info: Muted and looped, as browsers require.
video.description_info: Describe the video for screen readers.

faq.name: FAQ accordion
faq.question: Question
faq.exclusive: Only keep one answer open at a time

custom_liquid.name: Custom Liquid
custom_liquid.liquid_info: Add app snippets or Liquid code. Content here is not translatable.

apps.name: Apps
apps.info: Add an app block to this section.
apps.include_margins: Make section margins the same as theme

collection_grid.name: Product grid
collection_grid.info: Filters and sort options come from Shopify's Search & Discovery app. Configure them there, not here.

product_gallery.name: Product gallery
product_gallery.sticky: Stick to the top on desktop
product_gallery.group_by_variant_info: Shows only the media assigned to the selected flavour.

product_info.name: Product information
product_info.option_name_info: Must match the product option name exactly.
product_info.show_price_per_serving: Show price per serving under each size
product_info.sticky_mobile: Show a sticky bar on mobile
product_info.inventory_info: Uses the low stock threshold in theme settings.

key_ingredients.name: Key ingredients
key_ingredients.info: Renders the custom.key_ingredients metafield — a list of ingredient metaobjects.
key_ingredients.show_link: Link each ingredient to its page

supplement_facts.name: Supplement facts
supplement_facts.info: Rendered as a real HTML table from custom.supplement_facts. Never upload a panel as an image — an image cannot be indexed, translated, or read by a screen reader.

allergens.name: Allergens & certifications
allergens.info: Renders only when the allergen or certification metafields are populated.

complementary.name: Complementary products
complementary.info: Uses the Product Recommendations API with complementary intent. Set the pairings in the Search & Discovery app.

recently_viewed.name: Recently viewed
recently_viewed.info: Reads from the visitor's own browser. Nothing is stored on the server.

ingredients_index.name: Ingredient index
ingredients_index.info: Lists every entry in the ingredient metaobject.

coa_lookup.name: COA lookup
coa_lookup.info: Searches the coa_batch metaobject by batch number.

quiz.name: Product quiz
quiz.info: A client-side quiz. Results build a cart permalink for the recommended stack — no backend needed.
quiz.outcome_cart: Build a cart with the recommended stack
quiz.outcome_collection: Send them to a filtered collection
quiz.answer_products_info: Comma-separated product handles. Each match adds a point.

wholesale_form.name: Wholesale enquiry form
wholesale_form.info: Posts to Shopify's native contact form. Enquiries arrive at your store's customer email address.

main_account.name: Account
main_account.subscription_portal_info: Your subscription app's customer portal. The theme links out to it rather than rebuilding it.
